text:
Maya Chen: Quick KV cache regional sweep finished for quant-ggml bring-up. Posting highlights + links to charts https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kvcache/kv-regional-sweep :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Samir Patel: Nice—which GPUs and regions did you compare?
Maya Chen: H100 (us-east-1), A100 (us-west-2), H100 (eu-west-1) and a V100 pool in ap-south-1 for tail cases. Sequence dist used: short<=32 60%, mid128 25%, long512 10%, xl2048 5%. Eviction policies tested: LRU, segmented-LFU (seg-LFU), TTL(10m). Metrics: hit_rate, p50/p95/p99, tokens/s.
bench-bot: auto-summary: CSV uploaded https://s3.redwood.internal/kv-bench/1835000000.csv, dashboard snapshot attached.
Liam O'Neill: Can you paste the p99s per config?
Maya Chen: H100 us-east-1:
- LRU p99: 42ms (hit_rate 87%)
- seg-LFU p99: 35ms (hit_rate 90%)
- TTL p99: 48ms (hit_rate 84%)

A100 us-west-2:
- LRU p99: 58ms (hit_rate 80%)
- seg-LFU p99: 50ms (hit_rate 83%)
- TTL p99: 65ms (hit_rate 77%)

eu-west-1 (H100):
- LRU p99: 46ms (hit_rate 86%)
- seg-LFU p99: 38ms (hit_rate 89%)

ap-south-1 (V100):
- LRU p99: 120ms (hit_rate 68%)
- seg-LFU p99: 100ms (hit_rate 72%)

Maya Chen: Kernel tuning note: compared kern-opt-v1 vs kernel-opt-alloc-v2 (prefetch/alloc improvements). seg-LFU + kernel-opt-alloc-v2 gave ~10-12% extra p99 improvement on long seqs by reducing page-in stalls.
Irene Gomez: Nice. Throughput/ capacity numbers?
Maya Chen: Throughput (tokens/s aggregated):
- H100 LRU: 1900 tok/s
- H100 seg-LFU: 2200 tok/s (+16%)
- A100 LRU: 1400 tok/s
- A100 seg-LFU: 1600 tok/s (+14%)

Liam O'Neill: Any eviction churn or IO GC spikes?
Maya Chen: Eviction churn down ~30% with seg-LFU. TTL policy caused bursty IO during sweeps, produced SLO blips. Logs snippet:
```
2025-09-12T14:02:11Z evict[worker-3] evict_count=1234 policy=ttl io_wait_ms=92
2025-09-12T14:02:12Z cache[hwm] page_in_ms=210 page_out_ms=190
```
Samir Patel: For APAC long-tail, do we default to LRU or route to a different variant?
Maya Chen: Suggestion: route xl sequences to CPU-quantized local variant with a larger local cache to avoid remote page-in. Also consider admission control for xl sequences.
Irene Gomez: Did you test seqlen-aware admission?
Maya Chen: Not yet in this sweep — plan to add it next. Action items: 1) Canary seg-LFU on H100 us-east for 72h, 2) Enable kernel-opt-alloc-v2 on canary, 3) Update capacity curves + docs, 4) Run seqlen-bucket heatmaps and publish. PR: https://git.redwood/internal/rl/kvcache/PR/4023
bench-bot: Canary ticket created #KVCANARY-128, window 72h, monitoring alerts prewired.
Liam O'Neill: sgtm. Also add seqlen-aware admission to avoid queueing long requests and increasing p99 for short ones.
Maya Chen: Will open follow-up with per-seqlen benchmarks + heatmaps. Raw CSV: https://s3.redwood.internal/kv-bench/1835000000.csv
Samir Patel: Can you drop the local repro snippet?
Maya Chen: Repro command:
```
python tools/kv_bench.py --model quant-ggml --gpu h100 --region us-east-1 --seq-dist "60:32,25:128,10:512,5:2048" --policy seg-lfu --kernel kernel-opt-alloc-v2
```
Irene Gomez: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 9am PT to confirm rollout windows.
Maya Chen: @Irene added to calendar :calendar:
